programme.title: Great Destinations Europe
programme.desc: Great Destinations of the World takes you to some of the most beautiful and exotic places on the planet. With unbelievable views and fascinating commentary, you will discover these exquisite destinations hold more history than you ever imagined. Travel to picturesque locations in America, Africa, Asia, and Europe. Learn the history of each place, delight in the local cuisine, listen to native music, and leave with feeling like you just experienced some of the most exciting places on the planet.

programme.title: Painting The Town
programme.desc: Folk artist Eric Dowdle travels across North America, meeting the local people, sampling food, learning about culture and touring local attractions in an effort to determine what makes each place unique. Each episode culminates in the creation of a piece of colorful folk art that symbolizes the place Dowdle has visited.

programme.title: World Tour
programme.desc: In the thrilling travel show “World Tour,” viewers embark on captivating adventures to the most exotic corners of the planet. From the charming streets of Paris to the breathtaking landscapes of New Zealand, each episode offers new amazing places, cultures, and traditions. With inspiring stories from locals and unexpected discoveries, “World Tour” immerses viewers in the exciting world of travel and adventure.

programme.title: Downstream
programme.sub-title: Nicholasville, KY Jessamine County: Wine To Water
programme.desc: Opens with our hosts visiting Taylor Made Farm to discuss the role the region’s waters play in raising winning Thoroughbred horses. Carrie takes a ride on the Valley View Ferry learning some of the history of one of the oldest operating ferries in North America, as well as a visit to Camp Nelson, where water was pumped thousands of feet from the Kentucky River to supply Union troops and a whole lot of horses. Kyle will visit the 1922 House & Winery and after a pit-stop at the Dixie Café in Keene, KY he’ll delight in the flavors, sounds, smells and libations at the Wine & Vine Festival.
